interaction.model: Y = b0 + b_exposure X + b_moderator M + b_interaction X*M + covariates; M = 1 if moderator == comparison_level, 0 if reference_level
interaction.estimand: b_interaction: difference in the exposure slope (comparison minus reference group)
interaction.comparison_group_slope: b_exposure + b_interaction with variance V_ee + V_ii + 2 V_ei
interaction.moderator_in_covariates: removed from covariates; its main effect enters once via the interaction
interaction.missing_moderator: excluded by model-specific complete cases, counted, never assigned to a group

limitations: CR1 PSU-cluster uncertainty approximates, and is not, full ENUT complex-survey variance.
Observational, cross-sectional data: estimates are associations, not causal effects.
An interaction interval that includes zero is inconclusive; equivalence is not assessed.
